title: Vargur Guide
subtitle: Minmatar Marauder

# Vargur

---

The Vargur is a Minmatar marauder running a shield fit. It uses Bastion Module with autocannons for sustained close-range DPS.

## Key Points

- Activate Bastion at the start of each wave once in position.
- **Never enter Bastion if you have aggro and it is not safe.**
- Use Hail for close range max DPS, Barrage for medium range. Switch as needed.
- The Vargur has strong shield tank in Bastion — keep shield boosters running.
- Use your MJD to reposition between waves. Cannot be used in Bastion.
- Follow the fit on the fits page exactly.

## Bastion Timing

Enter Bastion once anchored. Exit before the wave ends to move to the next anchor.

## Anchoring

Follow FC anchor calls. The Vargur's MJD is your primary repositioning tool.
